name: alert
useFor: Use default for a fact the person should know before reading on (values are cited), warning for data that is partial or stale, success for a finished report, destructive for a source that failed. Lead with a Phosphor glyph at regular weight. Put a short note or one button in AlertAction. Use muted inside a Bone panel.
constraints: More than one alert for one message
source: Not in Figma (no risk or warning state yet): the cut frame of UI · Agent chat (443:433) with the chosen status colours, for a designer's review
title: Alert
description: A note in the cut frame: a 1px line around Bone with the chamfer at the top-left, a 16px glyph, a medium title and a secondary description. The line takes a status colour for success, warning and errors; muted is Fog.
